# HD Watchzone
> Movie, TV show and anime discovery, title information and local watchlists.

HD Watchzone helps visitors search titles, browse genres and explore overviews, cast, trailers, seasons and episodes. Browsing and saving a watchlist do not require an account. Saved titles and recently viewed items stay in the current browser and do not sync between devices.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://hdwatchzone.com/): Featured titles and catalog collections.
- [Movies](https://hdwatchzone.com/movies): Browse the movie catalog.
- [TV Shows](https://hdwatchzone.com/tv): Browse television series.
- [Anime](https://hdwatchzone.com/anime): Browse the anime catalog.
- [New & Popular](https://hdwatchzone.com/new): Recently released and popular titles.
- [Action Movies](https://hdwatchzone.com/genre/28): Action movie collection.
- [Comedy Movies](https://hdwatchzone.com/genre/35): Comedy movie collection.
- [Drama](https://hdwatchzone.com/genre/18): Drama movie collection.
- [Horror Movies](https://hdwatchzone.com/genre/27): Horror movie collection.
- [Sci-Fi Movies](https://hdwatchzone.com/genre/878): Science-fiction movie collection.
- [Animation](https://hdwatchzone.com/genre/16): Animated movie collection.

## Content

Title metadata, posters and community scores are supplied by The Movie Database (TMDB). HD Watchzone uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. A catalog listing does not confirm that a playable or authorized stream is available.

Video is supplied by independent external players. Availability, quality, languages, subtitles, ads and device support vary by provider. HD Watchzone does not host video files or guarantee ad-free, HD or uninterrupted playback. Only access content you are authorized to watch in your region.

This file is a plain-language site summary for services that choose to read it. It is not a special Google Search ranking or indexing mechanism.
